crossRefs.note: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah…
Now Heber the Kenite had separated himself from the Kenites, even from the children of Hobab, Moses’ brother-in-law…
that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship…

translations.web: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”
translations.bsb: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.”
translations.kjv: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do
translations.asv: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what good soever Jehovah shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
